_meta.notes: Agency products, not press coverage — the news view keeps them in their own strip. Every item carries the date its agency published it, parsed from the page; an undated item is dropped rather than stamped with the collection time. Items past their cadence are flagged stale rather than hidden. NOAA Climate.gov's ENSO blog is probed every run and deliberately excluded: it returns 200 with a fresh Last-Modified while its newest post is more than a year old.

bulletins.title: El Niño set to become very strong, raising risks of extreme weather into 2027
Weekly relative Niño 3.4 +2.45 °C, Troup SOI -13.7
bulletins.summary: BoM's operational ocean index for the week ending 30 August 2026. Its El Niño threshold is +0.8 °C, higher than CPC's +0.5. The SOI is negative, the El Niño-like sign, so the atmosphere is coupled to the ocean signal.
